title: OpenAI partners with Cerebras
summary: OpenAI partners with Cerebras to add 750MW of high-speed AI compute, reducing inference latency and making ChatGPT faster for real-time AI workloads.
body: OpenAI partners with Cerebras to add 750MW of high-speed AI compute, reducing inference latency and making ChatGPT faster for real-time AI workloads.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布与Cerebras达成战略合作，旨在通过部署750MW的高性能AI算力资源，显著降低大模型推理延迟。此次合作旨在优化ChatGPT的响应速度，以支持更复杂的实时AI工作负载。通过整合Cerebras的专用硬件架构，OpenAI试图在算力瓶颈日益严峻的背景下，提升其核心产品的推理效率，为大规模企业级应用提供更稳定的底层支撑。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI与Cerebras的算力合作直接关系到大模型推理性能的提升与基础设施建设。
